marketing.heroTitle: The daily planner with a ritual, without the $20.
marketing.heroSubtitle: Pick a few things in the morning, put them on the calendar, close the day. Morchitask does that and nothing else — for half what Sunsama costs.
marketing.ritualSubtitle: Not another endless list. A routine with a beginning and an end.
marketing.ritualPlanBody: Pull in what's left from yesterday, give the day an intention, estimate what each thing will take. The panel shows you what time you'd finish if it all goes the way you think.
marketing.ritualDayBody: Drag a task onto an hour and it stays there. The capacity bar turns red when you've over-committed, and names what to move so it fits.
marketing.ritualCloseBody: See what got done, how long it actually took against your estimate, and decide where each leftover goes. Then stop.
marketing.honestSubtitle: So you don't find out after paying.
marketing.honestNoTeams: It isn't for teams. You can share tasks with one person; there are no projects, assignments or permissions.
marketing.honestNoAi: No AI plans your day. You make the calls; the app only shows you what they cost.
marketing.honestNoOffline: It doesn't work offline. It installs as an app on your phone, but it needs a connection to read and write.
marketing.honestNoIntegrations: It connects to Google Calendar and Spotify. Nothing else, for now.
marketing.compareBody: Sunsama is $20 a month and does far more than most people use. Morchitask does the part you actually use — the ritual and the time-blocking — and charges $10. It isn't a stripped-down tier waiting for you to upgrade: it's all there is, and all there's going to be.
marketing.finalBody: No card, and no free plan afterwards. If you're not using it daily after 14 days, it wasn't for you.
marketing.footerTagline: A daily planner with a ritual.

pricing.title: One plan
pricing.subtitle: No cut-down tier, no add-ons, no free plan. This is all of it.
pricing.ctaNote: No card. If you don't use it, it just ends.
pricing.incRitual: The whole ritual: plan, schedule and close the day
pricing.incBlocking: Time-blocking against real capacity, estimate vs. tracked time
pricing.incShare: Share with one other person, at no extra cost
pricing.incFocus: Focus mode with Pomodoro, soundscapes and Spotify
pricing.whyBody: A free tier is paid for by the people who do pay, and it forces you to cripple the product so upgrading is worth it. I'd rather charge for one thing and let you try it for a full {days} days without a card.
pricing.compareUsBody: The ritual and the time-blocking. Nothing else.
pricing.compareSunsamaBody: Far more than most people use, at twice the price.
pricing.faqCancelA: Yes, from Settings. You keep access until the period you paid for ends.
pricing.faqDataQ: What happens to my data if I leave?
pricing.faqDataA: You can export it any time and delete your account from Settings. Deleting is permanent: everything goes, no copy kept.
pricing.faqTeamQ: Is it good for my team?
pricing.faqTeamA: No. You can share with one person, but there are no projects or assignments. If you need that, this isn't the tool.
pricing.faqTrialQ: What happens when the {days} days are up?
pricing.faqTrialA: Access stops, and we tell you before it does. Nothing is charged automatically, because we never asked for a card.

legal.draftNotice: Draft. Written to cover what Google asks for to verify the app; worth having a lawyer read it before charging anyone.
legal.privacyIntro: Morchitask is a daily planning app. This explains what it stores, why, and how to get it out or delete it.
legal.pS1Body: Your name, email and profile picture, which come from your Google account when you sign in. The content you create: tasks, notes, categories, goals, routines, schedules and tracked time. And your preferences: language, theme, daily capacity and reminders.
legal.pS2Title: What we do with your Google Calendar
legal.pS2Body: If you connect your calendar we ask for two permissions. «See events» shows your events for the day inside the Day view, so you can plan around them. «Manage events» creates, updates and deletes only the events matching time blocks you scheduled in the app. We don't read or touch anything else in your calendar, and we don't use that data for advertising or sell it.
legal.pS3Body: The database is on Neon and the app runs on Vercel. Files you attach are stored in Vercel Blob. Your Google token stays on the server and is never sent to the browser.
legal.pS4Body: Nobody, other than the providers above, who process it so the app works. If you invite someone into your space, they see only the tasks you marked as shared.
legal.pS5Body: From Settings you can export everything as a file, and delete your account. Deleting is permanent and immediate: tasks, notes, files and profile all go. We keep no copy.
legal.pS6Body: If this changes in a way that matters, we'll email you before it takes effect.
legal.termsIntro: The rules for using Morchitask. In plain language, and they're the ones that apply.
legal.tS1Body: A personal daily planning app, for one person, with the option to share tasks with one other. It isn't a team tool and it doesn't promise uninterrupted availability.
legal.tS2Body: You sign in with Google. You're responsible for what happens with your account and for the content you upload. One account is one person.
legal.tS3Body: The trial lasts {days} days and asks for no card. When it ends, access stops: nothing is charged automatically. If you subscribe, the price is ${price} per month or ${yearly} per year, and you can cancel any time from Settings, keeping access until the paid period ends.
legal.tS4Body: If something went wrong, write to us within 30 days and we'll refund it. We'd rather do that than have you stuck with something you don't use.
legal.tS5Body: Don't use the app for anything illegal, don't try to break it, don't resell access. We can close an account that does.
legal.tS6Body: The service is provided as is. We take backups and we're careful, but we're not liable for indirect losses. Export your data if it's critical.
legal.tS7Body: You can leave any time by deleting your account. If we ever had to shut the service down, we'd give at least 30 days' notice and you could export everything.
legal.tS8Body: Governed by the laws of the Argentine Republic.
